summary: Normalize scalar multiplication results with dup_strip and recursive dmp_strip so clear_denoms cannot retain coefficients that simplify to zero. Added EX regression covering canonical zero, terms_gcd, primitive, degree reduction at every variable level, one to three variables, and both convert settings. Reduced reproducer showed unstripped EX(0) and IndexError before fix; new regression failed before fix. Public bin/test on test_polytools.py, test_densearith.py, and test_densetools.py passed all 241 tests. Reviewed final diff.
